Why 100% soy wax?
Most mass-market candles are paraffin — a petroleum by-product. Ours are pure soy: a cleaner, slower burn with little to no soot, even fragrance as it melts, and spills that wash off with soap and water. Renewable, biodegradable, and kinder to indoor air.
Caring for your candle
First burn: let the wax melt to the edges (~2 hours) to prevent tunnelling. Every burn: trim the wick to 5 mm; max 4 hours at a stretch. After: when 1 cm of wax remains, wash the vessel — it's made for a second life. Slight frosting on soy is natural, and proof nothing artificial was added.
